post.description:
This API is used to search the information of products with open collaboration by category, commission rate, and keywords. It will return all products on the TikTok Shop Affiliate Product Marketplace that are in an open collaboration.
Creators can only search for open collaboration within the regions they are registered in the affiliate.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Pagination offset determines where you begin to search for. It's empty when raise your first request.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: The value of "page_size" must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 20.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description:
The returned results are sorted by the specified field. 

Possible values:
- commission_rate
- product_sales_price
- commission
- units_sold

Specify the sort order using the `sort_order` parameter.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the objects in the response. Default: ASC
Possible values:
- ASC: Ascending order
- DESC: Descending order

category.description: Restricts the products in the search results to those that are associated with the expressed product category.

id.description: The category identifier. Note that only first-level categories are supported.

commission_rate_range.description: The commission rate of the searched product needs to be limited within this range.

rate_ge.description: The commission rate must be greater than this value in order to be included in the search results. The commission rate is expressed in hundredths of a percent. For example, `3587` is a commission rate of `35.87%`. This value must a minimum of `1000`.

rate_lt.description: The commission rate must be less than this value in order to be included in the search results. The commission rate is expressed in hundredths of a percent. For example, `3587` is a commission rate of `35.87%`. This value must a minimum of `1000`.

sales_price_range.description: Restricts the products in the search results to those with prices greater than or equal to the expressed minimum price and less than the expressed maximum price.

amount_ge.description: The product price must be greater than this value in order to be included in the search results. The value must be greater than `0`.

amount_lt.description: The product price must be greater than this value in order to be included in the search results. The value must be greater than `0`. No upper bound is set if this property is not included.

title_keywords.description: A list of product keywords for searching. Product titles, or names, are loosely matched. Keywords in the list form a query and the resulting set of matching product names is based on the conjunctive operator `AND` between each keyword. For example, the keyword list `["Men", "Fashion"]` creates a query `"Men" AND "Fashion"` and the resulting set of matching product names contains the loosely matched conjuction of "Men" and "Fashion" such as "Male Fashionable". Maximum length of the list is 20 keywords. Maximum keyword string length is 255 characters.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set.

category_chains.description: A list of categories associated with the product. Maximum length of the list is `3` categories.

is_leaf.description: Set to `true` if this category is a leaf node. Set to `false` if not.

local_name.description: The name of the product in the category.

parent_id.description: The category identifier of the parent category.

commission.description: Metadata and data associated with the commission rates for the product.

amount.description: The commission amount.

rate.description: The commission rate in hundredths of a percent. For example, `3587` is a commission rate of `35.87%`. This value must a minimum of `1000`.  The range of this value is [100, 8000].

detail_link.description: The URL for the product's detail page.

has_inventory.description: Set to `true` if there are more than zero units of the product in inventory. Set to `false` if there are zero units in inventory.

original_price.description: The original price of the product.

maximum_amount.description: The highest original price of all SKUs of the product.

minimum_amount.description: The lowest original price of all SKUs of the product.

sale_region.description: The region where the product is offered for sale.

sales_price.description: Metadata and data associated with the sale price of the product

maximum_amount.description: The highest promotion price of all SKUs of this product.

minimum_amount.description: The lowest promotion price of all SKUs of this product.

shop.description: Data and metadata associated with the Seller's TikTok Shop.

units_sold.description: Total number of units sold. Units are indexed to SKU. Note that if the creator has not given permission for precise data sharing, this property will not be present.

total_count.description: Total count of products meeting the search criteria expressed in the request body.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

post.description:
Search Creator Affiliate Orders
This API allows the partner to retrieve a list of affiliate orders generated by a creator, returning the order ID and the product ID. Using this, the partner can track their affiliate-conversions on behalf of a creator, using the order ID.
For now, this API returns all historical affiliate orders by a creator. We do not provide any filtering mechanisms (based on timestamp) at this time. We will provide this functionality in a future iteration. Thus this API is technically a "Get Affiliate Orders List" at this stage, but it will be improved in the future to be a search based API (with robust filtering).

post.description: You, the creator, can use this API to query the fulfillment status for the received sample applications.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the field specified in the sort_field parameter. 
Default: ASC
Possible values:
ASC: Ascending order
DESC: Descending order

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description:
Some sorting fields are as follows:
- expired_time: sort by left time to fulfill.
- create_time: sort by fulfillment content create time.
Default value  is expired_time.

fulfillment_statuses.description:
A list of fulfillment statuses. The response is filtered to include sample fulfillments with the fulfillment_status field set to one of the specified values.  The possible values are:
- PENDING: The creator has not yet fulfilled the content creation obligation.
- ONGOING: Fulfillment is in progress; content has been created and is being evaluated against criteria.
- SUCCEED: Fulfillment has been successfully completed; the content meets the required standards.
- FAILED: Fulfillment failed; the content did not meet the required standards.
- OVERDUE: Fulfillment is overdue; the creator did not meet the deadline.
- SUSPEND: Fulfillment has been suspended.
- CANCELLED: Fulfillment has been cancelled, either by the creator or due to operational reasons.
- EXEMPTED: The creator is exempt from the fulfillment obligation.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

bound_product_status.description:
The marketing status of the product associated with the fulfillment order. This is an enumerated type with values:
- UNKNOWN: The marketing status of the product is unknown.
- LIVE: The product is available for fulfillment.
- OUT_OF_STOCK: The product is out of stock and cannot be fulfilled.
- SELLER_DEACTIVATE: The product has been deactivated by the seller.
- PLATFORM_DEACTIVATE: The product has been deactivated by the platform.
- NO_PLAN: There is no valid plan available for the creator to market the product.
- PERMANENT_DELETED: The product has been permanently deleted and is no longer available.

expiration_time.description:
Fulfillment deadline timestamp.
Usually the value is  `{you_receiving_sample_time} + 14Days`. But if you apply for fulfillment suspension, the value is `{you_receiving_sample_time} + 14Days + total_suspend_duration`.

- EXEMPTED: The creator is exempt from the fulfillment obligation.

post.description:
Search Creator Affiliate Orders
This API allows the partner to retrieve a list of affiliate orders generated by a creator, returning the order ID and the product ID. Using this, the partner can track their affiliate-conversions on behalf of a creator, using the order ID.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The number of results to be returned per page. Default: 20
Valid Range: [1-100]

create_time_ge.description:
Filter orders to show only those that are created on or after the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.

Note:
`create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` together constitute the creation time filter condition.
- If `create_time_ge` is filled but `create_time_lt` is empty, `create_time_lt` will default to the current time.
- If `create_time_lt` is filled but `create_time_ge` is empty, `create_time_ge` will default to the earliest shop time.

create_time_lt.description:
Filter orders to show only those that are created before the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.
Refer to notes in `create_time_ge` for more usage information.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set.

create_time.description: Time and date of order created, UTC+0 timing

delivery_time.description: Time and date order delivered, UTC+0 timing

skus.description: A list of SKUs associated with the order.

actual_bonus_commission.description: An object representing the actual bonus commission, calculated by multiplying the actual commission base by the commission bonus rate.

amount.description: The actual bonus commission amount.

actual_commission.description: Represents the final earnings of this sku, calculated by multiplying the actual commission base by the total commission rate, and then deducting the taxes or revenue sharing with the agency amount.

amount.description: The actual commission amount.

actual_commission_base.description: An object representing the actual commission base, calculated by multiplying the product sale price by the number of products sold, subtracting returned and refunded orders.

amount.description: The value of the actual commission base.
The actual fee creators receive from affiliate partners through commission rewards

actual_shop_ads_commission.description: An object representing the actual shop ads commission, calculated by multiplying the commission base by the shop_ads_commission_rate.

amount.description: The actual shop ads commission amount.

campaign_id.description: The campaign identifier associated with the order.

commission_bonus_rate.description: The commission bonus rate associated with the collaboration. Expressed in units of hundredths of a percent formatted as a string. The percent sign % is not included in the string. For example, 3000 represents a 30% commission.

commission_model.description:
Determine order commission be calculated based on fixed commission model or tiering
model

commission_rate.description: The total commission rate of this SKU, equal to the sum of standard commission rate + shop ads commission rate + bonus rate + reward rate. Expressed in units of hundredths of a percent formatted as a string. The percent sign % is not included in the string. For example, 3000 represents a 30% commission.

commission_tier_setting.description: Between Seller & Creator percentagecommission. When tiering commission model applied, will return each tier's commission rate seller set.

content_id.description: The content identifier for the creator content through which the order was created.

content_type.description:
The content format of the creator content through which the order was created.
Possible values:
- SHOP
- VIDEO
- LIVE
- PRE_LIVE
- PROMOTION_PAGE
- LINKSHARE

creator_commission_reward_rate.description: The commission reward rate affiliate partners allocate to creators

estimated_bonus_commission.description: An object representing the estimated bonus commission, calculated by multiplying the estimated commission base by the commission bonus rate.

amount.description: The estimated bonus commission amount.

estimated_commission.description: The estimated creator commission, calculated by multiplying the product sales price by the total number of products at the time of order creation.

amount.description: The estimated commission amount.

estimated_commission_base.description: An object representing the estimated base commission at the time of order creation.

amount.description: The estimated commission base amount.
The estimated fee creators receive from affiliate partners through commission rewards

estimated_shop_ads_commission.description: An object representing the estimated shop ads commission, calculated by multiplying the estimated commission base by the shop_ads_commission_rate

amount.description: The estimated shop ads commission rate.

open_collaboration_id.description: The open collaboration identifier associated with the order.

price.description: An object representing the localized price of the product.

amount.description: The value of the price associated with the product.

currency.description: The currency code of the price associated with the product.

product_name.description: The product name in the TikTok Shop.

quantity.description: The total number of SKUs per order, calculated by aggregating the number of ordered product SKUs associated with the order.

refunded_quantity.description: The total number of refunded SKUs associated with the order.

returned_quantity.description: The total number of returned SKUs associated with the order.

shop_ads_commission_rate.description: The commission rate received by a creator for a sale associated with a specific piece of content. Expressed in units of hundredths of a percent formatted as a string. The percent sign % is not included in the string. For example, 3000 represents a 30% commission.

shop_name.description: The name of the TIkTok Shop in which the product is offered for sale.

tag.description: A field for storing user-defined metadata for tracking purposes.

target_collaboration_id.description: The target collaboration identifier associated with the order.

status.description:
The current status of the order. Possible options are:
- UNSPECIFIED: The status of the order is undefined. It might be updated later.
- AWAITING PAYMENT：The order hasn't been paid yet, only estimated commission is available
- To-SETTLE：The order is waiting for settlement, only estimated commission is available
- SETTLED: The commission of the order is already settled.
- REFUNDED: The order has been returned/refunded/canceled by the buyer, and no commission will be settled.
- FROZEN: Possible fraud has been detected regarding the order. The commission will be unfrozen after the fraud is resolved.

total_count.description: Total count of orders in the response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

post.description: Get sample application list of creator.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: Pagination offset determines where you begin to search for. It's empty when raise your first request.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The value of "page_size" must be greater than 0 and less than or equal to 50.
Default 20

application_statuses.description:
The status of sample applications.
The possible enumerated values are:
- PENDING: The sample application is waiting for the seller's review.
- AWAITING_SHIPMENT: The application is approved, and the seller needs to ship the sample.
- SHIPPED: The sample has been shipped by the seller and is waiting for the creator to receive the package.
- CONTENT_PENDING: The creator has received the sample package and is expected to create content.
- REJECT_CANCELLED: The sample application has been rejected by the seller.
- OVERDUE_CANCELLED: The sample application has expired due to being overdue.
- UNFULFILL_CANCELLED: The creator did not fulfill the commitment to create content within the agreed timeframe.
- DEL_OPEN_COLLAB: Open collaboration has been deleted.
- SELLER_NOT_SHIP_CANCELLED: The seller did not ship the sample within the required timeframe.
- WITHDRAW_CANCELLED: The creator withdrew the sample application before the seller approved it.
- UNFULFILLABLE_CANCELLED: The application was cancelled due to reasons beyond the creator's control, making it impossible to create content.
- OPS_CANCELLED: The application was manually cancelled by operations staff.
- OPS_FAILED: The application was marked as failed by operations staff.
- OPS_ COMPLETED: The application was manually marked as completed by operations staff.
- COMPLETED: The application is complete, and the creator has posted the content.
This field allows for tracking the status of a sample application throughout its lifecycle, providing visibility into each stage of the process for sellers and creators.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

next_page_token.description: Page token to query next page orders, last page is empty string.

activity_id.description: The sample activity identifier id(only for sample activity).

creator_fulfillment.description: Fulfillment info for this sample application.

bound_product_status.description:
Represents the marketing status of a product associated with a fulfillment order. It indicates whether the product is available for marketing and fulfillment. The possible values are:
- UNKNOWN: The marketing status of the product is unknown.
- LIVE: The product is available and can be used for fulfillment.
- OUT_OF_STOCK: The product is out of stock and cannot be fulfilled.
- SELLER_DEACTIVATE: The product has been deactivated by the seller.
- PLATFORM_DEACTIVATE: The product has been deactivated by the platform.
- NO_PLAN: There is no valid plan available for the creator to market the product.
- PERMANENT_DELETED: The product has been permanently deleted and is no longer available.
This field helps sellers and creators understand the current status of products associated with fulfillment orders, ensuring that all parties are aware of the availability and marketing status of the products involved in sample applications and collaborations.

status.description:
Fulfillment status, It indicates the current status of the fulfillment process. The possible values are:
- PENDING: The creator is yet to fulfill the content creation obligation.
- ONGOING: Fulfillment is in progress; content has been created and is being evaluated against criteria.
- SUCCEED: Fulfillment has been successfully completed; the content meets the required standards.
- FAILED: Fulfillment failed; the content did not meet the required standards.
- OVERDUE: Fulfillment is overdue; the creator did not meet the deadline.
- SUSPEND: Fulfillment has been suspended.
- CANCELLED: Fulfillment has been cancelled, either by the creator or due to operational reasons.
- EXEMPTED: The creator has been exempted from the fulfillment obligation.

total_suspend_duration.description: Total suspension duration for fulfillment, in seconds.

id.description: The unique id of sample application.

main_order_id.description: The sample order is generated after the sample application is approved by seller.

status.description:
The status of sample applications.
The possible enumerated values are:
- PENDING: The sample application is waiting for the seller's review.
- AWAITING_SHIPMENT: The application is approved, and the seller needs to ship the sample.
- SHIPPED: The sample has been shipped by the seller and is waiting for the creator to receive the package.
- REJECT_CANCELLED: The sample application has been rejected by the seller.
- OVERDUE_CANCELLED: The sample application has expired due to being overdue.
- UNFULFILL_CANCELLED: The creator did not fulfill the commitment to create content within the agreed timeframe.
- FULFILLMENT_SUSPEND: the application fulfillment was paused due to the product status being unpromotable.
- DEL_OPEN_COLLAB: Open collaboration has been deleted.
- SELLER_NOT_SHIP_CANCELLED: The seller did not ship the sample within the required timeframe.
- WITHDRAW_CANCELLED: The creator withdrew the sample application before the seller approved it.
- UNFULFILLABLE_CANCELLED: The application was cancelled due to reasons beyond the creator's control, making it impossible to create content.
- OPS_CANCELLED: The application was manually cancelled by operations staff.
- OPS_FAILED: The application was marked as failed by operations staff.
- OPS_ COMPLETED: The application was manually marked as completed by operations staff.
- COMPLETED: The application is complete, and the creator has posted the content.
- TO_BE_POST: the creator has not posted videos/lives for this sample
- POST_IN_REVIEW: the creator has posted videos/lives which have not satisfied fulfillment rules.
- POST_FAILED: the creator has posted videos/lives and deleted them before completing sample fulfillment.
- CANCELED: this application(order) has been canceled.
This field allows tracking the status of a sample application throughout its lifecycle, providing visibility into each stage of the process for sellers and creators.

When no filter parameter is given, the API will return affiliate products recommended by algorithm with no specific limits.

The categories' unique IDs of the searched product needed to be limited in this param
Prerequisites:
- The length of category_ids is less than 1000

commission_rate_range.description: The commission rate range of the searched product needed to be limited

rate_ge.description:
The minimum value of commission rate in the search scope
Prerequisites:
- The value of must be greater than 100 or equal to 100, and less than 8000 or equal to 8000.
- This value equals the actual commission rate multiplied by 100. For example: 1200 means the actual commission rate is 12%
- Currently, the value will be automatically truncated to its floor hundred. For instance, 1239 will be truncated to 1200

rate_le.description:
The maximum value of commission rate in the search range
Prerequisites:
- The value of must be greater than 100 or equal to 100, and less than 8000 or equal to 8000.
- This value equals the actual commission rate multiplied by 100. For example: 1200 means the actual commission rate is 12%
- Currently, the value will be automatically truncated to its floor hundred. For instance, 1239 will be truncated to 1200

pool_ids.description:
The list of product pool IDs.
A product pool is edited by the operations, corresponding to a bunch of product IDs.
The product pool IDs will be provided by the operations offline.

Notice: Currently, if no title_keyword is given, only 1 pool_id is supported. So in this situation, the length of this field should be 1, otherwise we will only use the first pool.

price_ge.description:
The minimum price of the searched product needed to be limited
The unit is the local currency of the creator's marketing country.
Prerequisites:
- The value must be greater than or equal to zero
- If no value is given, it means 0
- Currently, the value needs to be an integer, otherwise we will automatically truncate it to its floor integer. For instance, 12.54 will be truncated to 12

price_le.description:
The maximum price of the searched product needed to be limited
The unit is the local currency of the creator's marketing country.
Prerequisites:
- The value must be greater than or equal to zero
- If no value is given, it means 0
- Currently, the value needs to be an integer, otherwise we will automatically truncate it to its floor integer. For instance, 12.54 will be truncated to 12

The exact product IDs the search needs. If this field is not empty, we will ignore other fields
Prereqsites:
The length of product_ids should be less or equal than 50

rating_ge.description:
The minimum value of shop rating for the search.
Prerequisites:
- The value of must be greater than or equal to 0, and less than 50 or equal to 50.
- This value equals the actual shop rating multiplied by 10. For example, 35 means the actual shop rating is 3.5

rating_le.description:
The maximum value of shop rating for the search.
Prerequisites:
- The value of must be greater than or equal to 0, and less than 50 or equal to 50.
- This value equals the actual shop rating multiplied by 10. For example, 35 means the actual shop rating is 3.5

sold_quantity_range.description: The sales volume range of the searched product needed to be limited

Prerequisites:
- The value must be greater than or equal to 0
- If no value is given, it means 0

quantity_le.description:
The maximum value of product sold quantity.
Prerequisites:
- The value must be greater than or equal to 0
- If no value or 0 is given, it means infinity

The keyword of product name, which will be used for fuzzy search on products.
There is no limit to the language of product name

sort_type.description:
The type of sort we applied to the result. Currently, there are 6 types:
1. "RECOMMENDED" Follow the algorithm recommended order
2. "BEST_SELLERS" Sort by historical sold numbers from high to low
3. "LOW_PRICE" Sort by price from low to high
4. "HIGH_PRICE" Sort by price from high to low
5. "NEWLY_RELEASED" Sort by the product edition time from late to early
6. "HIGH_COMMISSION_RATE" Sort by commission rate from high to low
If no value is given, we will follow algorithm recommended order, namely the same as "RECOMMENDED"

get.description: Developer can utilize this API to search and retrieve products information of shop which is bound by a specific creator with specific keywords.

parameters.name: title_keyword
parameters.description: The title keyword of the product you wish to search by.

parameters.name: sort_field
parameters.description: Sort fields include PRODUCT_ID, PRICE and SALE. If sort_field is empty or invalid, PRODUCT_ID will be set as default.

parameters.name: sort_order
parameters.description: Sort orders include DESC and ASC. If sort order is empty or invalid, DESC will be set as default.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Pagination count determines how many products you'll get after sending the request. 20 is a recommended number.
Valid Range: [1-100]

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: The pagination offset that determines where you begin your search. If you are making your first request, this will be empty.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

next_page_token.description: The pagination token is a cursor used for pagination. The token is returned in the previous pagination query to determine the current position. It will be empty when there aren't any products to search for.

products.description: The searched product list. It will be empty when there are no search results.

get.description:
Use this API to get a one-time TikTok deeplink, use this deeplink to launch TikTok app and land the user on the sample request page.
If the redirect_schema is valid, TikTok will redirect the user back to the 3rd party app after the sample request is submitted.
The deeplink generated can only be used by the creator who authorizes this API call.

parameters.name: redirect_schema
parameters.description: An URL schema for App redirection after sample request

parameters.name: campaign_id
parameters.description: If the product belongs to a TAP campaign, a campaign_id is required.

parameters.name: collaboration_id
parameters.description: If the product belongs to a seller collaboration, a collaboration_id is required.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

deeplink.description:
Use this deeplink to invoke TikTok:
aweme://sample_request?product_id=123456&sku_id=123456&token=iei938d93sd02
This deeplink can only be used by the creator who authorizes this API call.
This deeplink expires in 30 minutes.
